prompts.prompt:
Create one sparse AIRBORNE WHIPPED-CREAM SPLASH game-effect sprite. The reference is ONLY for the warm ivory cream colour and clean hand-painted cartoon arcade rendering; do not copy its puddle or crumbs.
There are just FOUR to SIX small separate cream droplets suspended in mid-air, with large clear transparent gaps. A mix of small rounded beads and a couple of short stretched teardrops. Restrained cream volume: no large blob, no broad sheet of liquid, no connected splash crown, no puddle, no cake pieces, no crumbs or decorations. The droplets are soft thick ivory whipped cream with very pale peach undersides, subtle highlights and a thin warm outline matching the reference; not clear water, not yellow slime. No glows, motion lines, smoke, contact shadow, floor, container, characters or text.
Composition: one small loose natural droplet cluster inside a SQUARE canvas, about80to90percent of the canvas remaining transparent air. Entire droplets fully visible, generous margins. A droplet group, not a grid or sprite sheet. Genuine transparent alpha. Intended final size512x512. Sharp clean game-sprite detail.
Five sparse droplets in a gentle upward fan: two small elongated droplets angled outwards, three little rounded cream beads at different heights. Uneven natural spacing.
